Title: Azure Sphere OS update 20.08 is now available for compatibility testing

Body.Content:
The Azure Sphere 20.08 OS quality update is now available for evaluation via the Retail Eval feed. The retail evaluation period provides 14 days for backwards compatibility testing. During this time, please verify that your applications and devices operate properly with this release before it's deployed broadly via the Retail feed. The Retail feed will continue to deliver OS version 20.07 until we publish 20.08 in two weeks.

The 20.08 evaluation release includes an OS update; it does not include an updated SDK. In addition, we’re releasing three new Sample applications.

For more information on what’s included in this release, please read our post on the Internet of Things on Microsoft Tech Community.

For more information on Azure Sphere OS feeds and setting up an evaluation device group, see Azure Sphere OS feeds.

If you encounter problems:

For self-help technical inquiries, please visit Microsoft Q&A or Stack Overflow. If you require technical support and have a support plan, please submit a support ticket in Microsoft Azure Support or work with your Microsoft Technical Account Manager. If you do not have a support plan and require technical support, please explore the Azure support plans.
